title: AICP WebSocket Event
description: Envelope schema for real-time events delivered over the AICP WebSocket channel.

eventId.description: Globally unique identifier for this event.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred.

source.description: DID or identifier of the entity that originated this event.

subject.description: DID or identifier of the entity this event pertains to.

data.description: Event-specific payload. Structure varies by event type.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical event payload for authenticity verification.

EventType.description: The type of event. Uses dotted namespacing by domain.
